# Hero classes
# Skills sheets: powers/trees/rd_<class>.txt (tools/gen_skills.py)
# Starting clothes are Random Dungeon items (leather; apprentice robes for
# the mage) so the whole kit matches the rest of the game.
#
# Full override of empyrean_campaign/engine/classes.txt (mods can't merge
# this file, only replace it). The four
# classes: Warrior (was Brute), Rogue (was Scout), Cleric (new), Mage (was
# Adept). Starting weapons are the Iron tier from items/categories/rd_items.txt
# (generated by tools/gen_content.py).
#
# Rogue: a working melee dagger attack (powers/rogue.txt, id=5000) instead of
# the Scout's ranged basic attacks, which were meta_power placeholders. It
# also has Shoot (42) on the bar: meta_power, inert until a bow is equipped
# (bows carry replace_power=42,44), then it becomes a real arrow shot. The
# Rogue starts with a Short Bow in the bag for that.
# Cleric: Holy Strike (5001) + Heal (5002), powers/cleric.txt.
#
# Saves store the class NAME; alias= maps the old names (Brute, Scout, Adept)
# to the new classes, so old saves keep their class and base stats.

[class]
name=Warrior
power_tree=powers/trees/rd_warrior.txt
alias=Brute
description=Warriors rely on physical strength, heavy armor and big weapons. Primary attribute: Physical
equipment=5201,5203,5204,5202,5010,5400
equipment_set=2,5201,5203,5204,5202
carried=2,2,2,2,2,3,3,3,3,3
primary=physical,4
primary=defense,1
powers=7
actionbar=162,163,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,7
default_power_tab=0

[class]
name=Rogue
power_tree=powers/trees/rd_rogue.txt
alias=Scout
description=Rogues strike fast and silent with daggers, and shoot from afar with bows. Primary attribute: Offense
equipment=5201,5203,5204,5202,5000
equipment_set=2,5201,5203,5204,5202
carried=2,2,2,2,2,3,3,3,3,3,5131
primary=offense,4
primary=defense,1
powers=5000
actionbar=162,163,42,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,5000
default_power_tab=0

[class]
name=Cleric
power_tree=powers/trees/rd_cleric.txt
description=Clerics fight with mace and shield and heal themselves with holy magic. Primary attributes: Mental and Physical
equipment=5201,5203,5204,5202,5028,5400
equipment_set=2,5201,5203,5204,5202
carried=2,2,2,2,2,3,3,3,3,3
primary=mental,2
primary=physical,2
primary=defense,1
powers=5002
actionbar=162,163,5002,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,5001,5002
default_power_tab=0

[class]
name=Mage
power_tree=powers/trees/rd_mage.txt
alias=Adept
description=Mages cast powerful spells from a distance. Primary attribute: Mental
equipment=5206,5208,5209,5207,5138
equipment_set=2,5206,5208,5209,5207
carried=2,2,2,2,2,3,3,3,3,3
primary=mental,4
primary=defense,1
powers=122
actionbar=162,163,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,116,122
